# tests/fixtures/minigame — what these files are NOT

Canned responses for `--mock-llm`. They prove the ORCHESTRATION — the design
gate, the GER loop, the circuit breaker, the human gate, and the build
contract — executes end to end with no API key. **They are not design work**;
every mock artifact is banner-stamped and every canned verdict carries
`[MOCK FIXTURE]`.

The script walks every path in one propose run:

| slot | scripted path |
|---|---|
| first-contact-hope/-fear, vigil-hope | accepted round 0 |
| vigil-fear | `signals` names a text label → **deterministic** C5 WORDLESS catch → repaired → accepted |
| holding-hope | Fear's texture in Hope's slot → mock Judge FAILs POLE-SYMMETRY → repaired → accepted |
| holding-fear | three versions fail C3 (shift-key), C4 (gold_coins), C3 (arrow-keys) → **ESCALATED** — and the candidates doc marks it unselectable |

`programmer.json` is a hand-authored minimal patch that passes the REAL
post-checks against the REAL slice — proof the contract is satisfiable, not
merely specified. The live build phase replaces it with the selected
design's playable overlay.
